ctx.x: Savoy, yes. But, there is also that other company…Okay, so it’s mainly Savoy. But, that was before Ozzie Cadena came along, you know? Teddie has a fantastic memory. She remembers telephone numbers from 1954! (Laughs)
It’s a little failing now. Sven: That’s alright (laughs).
He used to rely on me for it. He’d say, “Can you tell me what date this person did that, and they did this?" (Laughs)
